crossRefs.note: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.
Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
“Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
But after some days, Felix came with Drusilla, his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul, and heard him concerning…

translations.web: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity, than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
translations.bsb: Better a poor man who walks with integrity than a rich man whose ways are perverse.
translations.kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
translations.asv: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, Than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
